title: Triple-Take
summary: A number of art installations at the newly opened section of Biidaasige Park have captured the hearts of visitors for their whimsy and invitation to engage. The one by Hank Willis Thomas, named Ernest and Ruth (Exuberant Pink) places a speech bubble next to Toronto Harbour and its great view of the skyline, especially at sunset. While it alludes to the place of everyone's voice in public discourse, it also simply makes for a great place to compose or frame a fun, dramatic, engaging shot.
